failure_modes.name: Entity_Coreference_Error
failure_modes.evidence: The claim states 'He also had a role in the TV series Carl Levitt.' The solver correctly identifies that Carl Levitt is a CHARACTER on 'Barney Miller' (played by Ron Carey), not a TV series name. However, the claim's use of 'He' (referring to Max Gail) in connection with 'the TV series Carl Levitt' demonstrates entity confusion—treating a character name as if it were a series title. The solver recognizes this error in summary_1: 'Carl Levitt is a CHARACTER (played by Ron Carey) on the television sitcom "Barney Miller", not the name of a TV series itself' and summary_2: 'Carl Levitt is a character (played by Ron Carey) on the TV series "Barney Miller", not the name of a TV series itself.'

failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: In summary_1, the solver states: 'there is NO confirmation in the provided passages that Max Gail appeared in "D.C. Cab"' and lists this as requiring verification. However, hop 2 retrieval clearly provided passage [4]: 'D.C. Cab (also known as Street Fight) is a 1983 American comedy film, starring Max Gail, Adam Baldwin, Mr. T, Charlie Barnett, Gary Busey, Marsha Warfield, and Whitman Mayo.' This directly confirms Max Gail starred in D.C. Cab. Summary_2 correctly recognizes this: 'passage [4] confirms Max Gail starred in the 1983 film "D.C. Cab".' The solver in summary_1 missed evidence that was present in the retrieved passages.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: The hop 3 query is formulated as: 'Did Max Gail appear in the 1983 film "D.C. Cab"? Was Jim Moody in "D.C. Cab" and did he play a character named Arnie? Is there a TV series titled "Carl Levitt" or is Carl Levitt only a character name on "Barney Miller"?' This is a compound multi-part query bundling three separate verification targets as yes/no questions rather than as entity-focused retrieval queries. The retriever cannot efficiently process this form—it needs entity names and topics, not interrogative questions.
